name: Assisted dial-in
author: Maximilian Rink and Decaid contributors
description: Local assisted dial-in with bean context, post-brew flavour, brew metrics and recovered algorithm replay.

GrinderId.label: Grinder identity
GrinderId.description: Stable identity of the current grinder, used only if the current workflow omits it; historical shots are never backfilled.

GrinderModel.label: Grinder model
GrinderModel.description: Optional grinder model used for comparisons.

BurrIdentity.label: Burr identity
BurrIdentity.description: Optional burr identity or replacement epoch.

CalibrationEpoch.label: Calibration epoch
CalibrationEpoch.description: Optional user managed calibration label; it is never inferred.

CurrentSetting.label: Current grinder setting
CurrentSetting.description: Recorded current setting used for suggestions; it is never written to a grinder.

SettingUnit.label: Setting unit
SettingUnit.description: Unit or coordinate system for the current setting, such as a dial mark or deci-micrometre.

DialCalibration.label: Dial calibration (JSON)
DialCalibration.description: Optional owner-supplied JSON with model, burrIdentity, calibrationEpoch, dialA, ddDumA, dialB, ddDumB, dialMin and dialMax. It is used only to display native dial values and must match the current grinder context.

TargetTimeSec.label: Target brew time (seconds)
TargetTimeSec.description: Default target used by rich suggestions.

TimeToleranceSec.label: Time tolerance (seconds)
TimeToleranceSec.description: Deadband around the target brew time.

EvidenceMaxAgeDays.label: Evidence age limit (days)
EvidenceMaxAgeDays.description: Only recent shots with recorded feedback within this age are used for rich suggestions.

StepSize.label: Calibrated step size
StepSize.description: Owner-calibrated setting movement. Zero disables numeric proposals.

NumericFinerDelta.label: Numeric finer direction
NumericFinerDelta.description: Owner-confirmed numeric sign (-1 or +1). Zero disables numeric proposals.

MinSetting.label: Minimum setting
MinSetting.description: Optional calibrated lower bound. Equal minimum and maximum disable bounds.

MaxSetting.label: Maximum setting
MaxSetting.description: Optional calibrated upper bound. Equal minimum and maximum disable bounds.

BeanType.label: BeanType
BeanType.description: Explicit current BeanType; historical shots require saved context or per-shot operator confirmation.

RoastLevel.label: RoastLevel
RoastLevel.description: Explicit current RoastLevel; historical shots require saved context or per-shot operator confirmation.
